company.name: Classy Games
company.shortDescription: Classy Games is an independent video game development studio focused on creating imaginative, engaging, and accessible gaming company.
company.description:
Classy Games Studios is an independent video game development company founded in 2020 by Jamie McClenaghan. Operating across Northern Ireland, the United Arab Emirates, and Saudi Arabia, the studio focuses on creating culturally diverse and imaginative gaming experiences while helping bridge the European and Middle Eastern gaming markets.

The company was established during the COVID-19 pandemic after McClenaghan transitioned from a teaching career into game development. The studio initially explored a gamified well-being application before shifting its primary focus toward entertainment-focused video games with an emphasis on creativity, humor, and accessible gameplay experiences.

Its first released title, Orbital, is a fast-paced Android game centered on timing and decision-making mechanics. The studio’s flagship upcoming project is Silly Suspects, a comedic first-person detective RPG planned for Early Access release on Steam. The game features procedurally generated environments, unusual crime scenarios, and eccentric characters, blending humor with murder mystery gameplay.

Classy Games Studios primarily operates on a direct-to-consumer business model through digital distribution platforms such as the Google Play Store and Steam. Revenue generation is expected to come from game sales, potential downloadable content, and community-driven engagement within indie gaming ecosystems.

In May 2025, the company secured seed funding from Merak Capital and its accelerator platform Exel by Merak. The investment was aimed at accelerating development of Silly Suspects, expanding the studio’s remote-first workforce, and strengthening its role within Saudi Arabia’s growing gaming sector aligned with Saudi Vision 2030.

The studio promotes a player-first philosophy and advocates for healthy work-life balance within both its workplace culture and game design principles, emphasizing enjoyable and stress-relieving gameplay experiences over addictive engagement mechanics.
